author: reek
body: The subject is the SEAM, not the driver. e1000-bringup already asserts d.e-mac off a device returned by e1000-init directly; nothing asked what address net-driver-mac answers, and that is the value every frame the stack sends is sourced from.

author: reek
body: The fallback address is written out here rather than taken from NetDriver. A test that imports its comparand from the chapter it is judging cannot fail when that comparand moves, and this row exists precisely to say the seam did NOT answer this value.
